purpose: menqstudio/OS root canonical startup read order. Every new session (Claude or ChatGPT) reads these IN ORDER, IN FULL, before acting. GitHub is the single source of truth; a textual 'I read it' is not evidence. Mirrors the human-facing START_HERE.md / CLAUDE.md startup law in machine-readable form. (The engine/ half has its own engine/config/canonical-read-manifest.json with engine-relative paths — that is a separate track.)
notes: NEXT_CHAT.md holds the exact current branch/PR/HEAD/blockers/next-action and must be updated in the same commit as any state change; config/current_state.json is the machine-readable mirror the human docs must agree with (tools/check_coordination.py validates the agreement). PROJECT_STATE.md and TASKS.md are the live coordination board. Do not add stale or nonexistent paths here. The Wave 3b-1 normative docs (WAVE_3B1_EXECUTION_BINDING_MAP.md, WAVE_3B1B_EXECUTION_BINDING_ADDENDUM.md) live on PR #31's branch and are added here only when 3b-1 merges to main.
